beats: Dad's hours were tracked by GPS, but payday only ever showed one number: whatever the payslip said.
There was no way to tell if that number matched the hours he actually worked.
Now his work report compares GPS-tracked time against the payslip, day by day.
Training, extra hours, unpaid time — every day gets tagged against what was actually paid.
Any gap between hours worked and hours paid now shows up in red, impossible to miss.
